---
title: "Research"
---

My research lies at the intersection of Bayesian statistics, Bayesian
nonparametrics, network modeling, and computational statistics. I develop
flexible Bayesian methods for modeling complex and structured data, with a
particular focus on heterogeneous populations, dependent structures, and
scalable computational approaches.

## Research Interests

Bayesian nonparametrics, network modeling, computational statistics, and Bayesian
statistics.
